assets.description: Imaginary cream boutique hotel with turquoise pool and palms on a dramatic volcanic Atlantic coastline in warm late-afternoon light.
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: illustrative website hero and lodging portfolio concept for Aireal Estudio, a Tenerife creative marketing and AI studio.
Primary request: Create one cinematic editorial aerial photograph of an IMAGINARY boutique hotel on a volcanic Atlantic coastline, with cobalt ocean, an architectural cream building, a small turquoise pool, lush palms, geometric sunlit terrace, and rich terracotta details.
Style/medium: Premium architecture magazine photography, natural realistic materials and landscape.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape 3:2. Strong diagonal coastal division, hotel in the center and lower part of frame. Natural sense of drone height and dimensional terrain. One coherent full-bleed photograph.
Lighting/mood: Late afternoon natural light, warm sunlight, clear shadows, quiet premium atmosphere.
Constraints: Entirely imaginary lodging concept, do not imitate a real Tenerife property. No close-up people, labels, typography, logos, watermarks, borders or collage.
Return the generated asset and its local saved file path so it can be copied into a deployment ZIP.
